title: 夜雪
author: 白居易
intro: A poem about snow that never shows the snow: the poet feels his quilt go cold, sees the window glow, and hears bamboo snapping under the weight. Everything reaches him through touch, light and sound.
analysis: 这首诗写夜里下大雪，可是诗人一直躺在床上，并没有亲眼看雪。他是怎么知道的呢？第一句是感觉：被子和枕头冷得让人吃惊。第二句是视觉：窗户亮了起来——雪光把夜晚照亮了。第三句是推断：夜深了，雪一定下得很大。第四句是听觉：不时听到竹子被雪压断的声音。诗人从触觉、视觉、听觉一步步写，没有正面描写雪花，却让读者感到雪又大又重，这叫“侧面描写”。“折竹声”更是用声音衬出夜的安静：四周静得能听见竹子折断。这首诗写于诗人被贬官的第二年冬天，冷被、寒窗、独自醒着的夜，也透出一点孤单。
analysisEn: This poem is about a heavy snowfall at night — yet the poet never actually looks at the snow; he is lying in bed. So how does he know? Line one is touch: the quilt and pillow are surprisingly cold. Line two is sight: the window has turned bright — snow-light glowing in the dark. Line three is reasoning: it’s late, so the snow must be heavy. Line four is sound: now and then he hears bamboo snapping under its weight. Moving from touch to sight to hearing, he never describes a single snowflake, yet we feel how deep and heavy the snow is. Showing something through its effects instead of describing it directly is called cèmiàn miáoxiě (indirect description). The sound of breaking bamboo also highlights the silence: it is so quiet he can hear it. The poem dates from his second winter after being demoted, and the cold bed, the bright window and the lonely, wakeful night carry a touch of solitude too.
background: Bai Juyi (772–846) was demoted in 815 to Jiangzhou (today’s Jiujiang) after angering powerful officials. This poem is traditionally dated to the winter of 816, during his exile there.
pronunciation: 衾 qīn（被子），生僻字；雪重 zhòng；折竹 zhé（折断）。
version: 采用通行教材文本，各版本基本无异文。

lines.lit: Already surprised that quilt and pillow are cold,
lines.en: Surprised to find my quilt and pillow cold,

lines.lit: again I see the window bright.
lines.en: I see the window glowing pale.

lines.lit: Deep in the night I know the snow is heavy:
lines.en: Deep in the night, I know the snow lies thick —

lines.lit: at times I hear the sound of bamboo breaking.
lines.en: now and then, the crack of bamboo giving way.

words.note: 现代汉语说“又”；“重复”“复习”里还有。
这里指雪下得大、积得厚。
“时”= 时时、不时；“闻”= 听到，今天“闻”多指用鼻子闻。
现代汉语“折断”；读 shé 时也表示断，这里按通行注音读 zhé。

imagery.name: 雪
imagery.zh: 雪始终没有直接出现，只通过冷、亮、竹折声让人感到它又大又重。
imagery.en: The snow is never shown directly; we know how heavy it is only through the cold, the glow and the snapping bamboo.

imagery.name: 竹
imagery.zh: 竹子被雪压断，用声音写出雪的大，也衬出寒夜的寂静。
imagery.en: Bamboo breaking under the snow — a sound that shows how heavy the snow is and how silent the night.
